answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 48835 Country: India Title: Using of oil with alcohol Question: I am 24 year old guy, suffering from hair loss problem. I had been to a Muslim doctor and he suggested certain liquid hair oil which contains alcohol to regain my hair. Now my question is can I use products which contains alcohol and offer salah. Answer ID: 48835 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1673/1339/B=11/1434) It is not right to apply such oil and pray salah with that. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
